used.text: Specification of Diagnostics AUTOSAR AP R25-11 It is assumed, that there is only a single proximity_challenge present at any point in time, that is valid for all SOVD clients and all operations . Therefore, a typical application implementing ara::diag::SovdProximityChallenge does not need to manage an individual proximity_challenge for each requested operation and for each client. The lifetime of a proximity_challenge is typically set to a fixed time by the appli- cation (e.g. 2 minutes). If further complexity, such as different proximity_challenges per client are needed, the ara::diag::MetaInfo object can be evaluated by the application, to implement client or operation specific proximity_challenges . But in most cases this will not be necessary. [SWS_DM_01398] Providing the SOVD operation proximity_challenge Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04262 ⌈ If a SOVD operation has DiagnosticSovdOperation.proximityProofRe- quired set to TRUE , in each response body where the attribute proxim- ity_challenge is required, the Diagnostic Server instance shall return the attribute in the response body of the SOVD method with the value returned by ara:: diag::SovdProximityChallenge::GetChallenge . ⌋ [SWS_DM_01397] SOVD operation mode Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04262 ⌈ The SOVD attribute modes of a SOVD operation shall not be supported. ⌋ [SWS_DM_01395] Validation of SOVD operation proximity_response Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04262 ⌈ If a SOVD request body contains a proximity_response , the Diagnostic Server instance shall call the method ara::diag::SovdProximityChal- lenge::ValidateResponse with the parameter proximityResponse set to the con- tent from the request body and consider the proximity_challenge valid, if kProx- imityChallengeValidationSuccessful is returned. ⌋ [SWS_DM_02171] Operation execution without required proxim- ity_challenge Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04262 ⌈ If a SOVD method to execute an operation is received and the DiagnosticSovd- Operation.proximityProofRequired is set to TRUE and the SOVD request body does not contain a proximity_response , the DM shall deny the request and return an SOVD error 400 (Bad Request). ⌋ 215 of 1171 Document ID 723: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_Diagnostics

It is assumed that operations often only allow a single instance. 7.3.3.5.5.6 Operations – Terminate execution of an operation [SWS_DM_01392] Support of SOVD method Terminate execution of an Operation Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04262 ⌈ For each DiagnosticSovdOperationStop , the Diagnostic Server in- stance shall provide the SOVD method Terminate execution of an Opera- tion according to ASAM SOVD[5][14]. ⌋ [SWS_DM_01391] SOVD method Terminate execution of an Operation – proximity_response Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04262 ⌈ The proximity_response in the request body of SOVD method Terminate the Execution of an Operation shall be validated using ara::diag::SovdProx- imityChallenge::ValidateResponse . ⌋ [SWS_DM_02179] Operation terminate execution Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04262 ⌈ If a SOVD method to terminated an operation is received and, if needed, the proxim- ity_challenge validation according to [SWS_DM_02173] succeeded, the DM shall call ara::diag::SovdOperationExecution::Terminate of the SovdOp- erationExecution assigned to the execution-id [SWS_DM_02177] of the re- quest body. Terminating an SovdOperationExecution will discard the SovdOperationExe- cution instance and further method calls on the execution-id are no longer pos- sible and the result of such a call is undefined . ⌋ 7.3.3.5.5.7 Operations – Read the status of an operation execution [SWS_DM_01393] Support of SOVD method Read the Status of an Opera- tion Execution Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04262 ⌈ For each DiagnosticSovdOperationGetStatus , the Diagnostic Server instance shall provide the SOVD method Read the Status of an Operation Execution according to ASAM SOVD[5][14]. ⌋ 218 of 1171 Document ID 723: AUTOSAR_AP_SWS_Diagnostics
